name: Izuma's starship
description: A starship was used by Lord Izuma's raiders sometime between 19 BBY and 1 BBY. The vessel was an XS stock light freighter that the raiders used to transport and control reprogrammed B1-series battle droids with the intent of capturing and controlling Meevai Village on the planet Keelia. It was later destroyed by Valco during the liberation of Meevai Village.
